people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translations.bsb: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
translations.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
translations.asv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I should do unto you?
